d: A gunfighter reconciles with his estranged mother to protect her from greedy land-grabbers.
Don Jose (Franco Nero), a Spanish soldier, meets the beautiful Carmen (Tina Aumont) and instantly becomes obsessed with her.
The son of a Mexican bandit finds a village that is controlled by a former Confederate officer who steals from the locals.
During a local screening of a film, a patron is hit by an unexpected bullet, leaving the police to sift through a cinema full of potential culprits.
